title: Mortgage (Amendment)
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE MORTGAGE ACT.

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Mortgage (Amendment) Act, No. 27 of 1987.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Mortgage (Amendment) Act, No. 27 of 1987.

body.heading: Amendment of section 114 of Chapter 89.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 114 of the Mortgage Act is hereby amended in subsection (5) of that section by the substitution for the words" (not exceeding fifty rupees for each sitting) ", of the words" (not exceeding one hundred and fifty rupees for each sitting) ".
body.text: Section 114 of the Mortgage Act is hereby amended in subsection (5) of that section by the substitution for the words" (not exceeding fifty rupees for each sitting) ", of the words" (not exceeding one hundred and fifty rupees for each sitting) ".
